build_depth_classification_regularizer: build a DepthClassificationRegularizer with system and cfg to predict depth probabilities from rays
run_forward_depth_probs: run the forward pass on rays to get depth probabilities, rgb lookup, and cost volume
compute_depth_from_probs: compute expected depth values from depth probability distributions using weighted depth slices
calculate_ray_outputs: calculate rgb lookup, lookup weights, and cost volume for backprojected ray points across depth slices
compute_consistency_loss: compute color and depth consistency loss with jittered rays and lookup loss for training
